info.title: EMI-at-Counter Copilot customer API (Phase 3A contract)
info.description: REST contract for the merchant and customer apps. JSON is camelCase, money is integer paise (never a float) and every error is an RFC 7807 problem with a stable code.

post.summary: Start a customer session from the shop's QR
post.description: STUB (DESIGN_SPEC §4 sample data) until Phase 3C; not mounted in the main app (ADR 0012). Money is integer paise, shares are integer basis points, errors are application/problem+json. Trades the QR token for a session token, sent as X-Customer-Session-Token on every later call. Sample tokens: stub-qr-4821 (the design's customer) and stub-qr-4822 (the second, Risky example). Scanning a sample QR again restarts its sample session; the earlier token stops working.

post.summary: Allow or skip the comfort check
post.description: STUB (DESIGN_SPEC §4 sample data) until Phase 3C; not mounted in the main app (ADR 0012). Money is integer paise, shares are integer basis points, errors are application/problem+json. Needs the X-Customer-Session-Token header. With consent, reads the customer's synthetic monthly inflow and existing EMIs and returns them to the customer; the shop never sees them. Skipping reads nothing and plans then show without bands. The comfort check is advice, not a credit decision. Needs the confirmed budget.

get.summary: Compare every EMI plan for the budget
get.description: STUB (DESIGN_SPEC §4 sample data) until Phase 3C; not mounted in the main app (ADR 0012). Money is integer paise, shares are integer basis points, errors are application/problem+json. Needs the X-Customer-Session-Token header. Lists every plan quoted for the item: plans within the budget first, then by amount above it, then by extra in total, tenure and offer id (ADR 0020). No plan is ever hidden: when none fits, all are listed with amountAboveBudgetInPaise. reasonCodes state facts only. comfort is null when the comfort check was skipped. Needs the confirmed budget.

post.summary: Find smarter alternatives to a plan
post.description: STUB (DESIGN_SPEC §4 sample data) until Phase 3C; not mounted in the main app (ADR 0012). Money is integer paise, shares are integer basis points, errors are application/problem+json. Needs the X-Customer-Session-Token header. Recomputes, with the EMI engine, a down payment (the gap to the budget over the plan's tenure, rounded up to ₹1,000), every longer plan for the item and the cheaper 64 GB model. Every option is kept, even one that does not lower the monthly amount; hasLowerMonthlyAlternative false is the 'nothing better' state. Needs the confirmed budget.

post.summary: Send the one-time code for consent
post.description: STUB (DESIGN_SPEC §4 sample data) until Phase 3C; not mounted in the main app (ADR 0012). Money is integer paise, shares are integer basis points, errors are application/problem+json. Needs the X-Customer-Session-Token header. Sends a 6-digit code to the customer's phone (the stub code is 123456; nothing is sent). The code lasts 5 minutes; a new one can be asked for after 30 seconds, which restarts the lifetime.

post.summary: Agree to the chosen plan with the one-time code
post.description: STUB (DESIGN_SPEC §4 sample data) until Phase 3C; not mounted in the main app (ADR 0012). Money is integer paise, shares are integer basis points, errors are application/problem+json. Needs the X-Customer-Session-Token header. Names the exact selection shown on C9: the offer, the product (null for the session's item, or the cheaper model) and the down payment (0, or exactly the one suggested). It is re-quoted server-side; if the shown monthly or total no longer match, the answer is 409 SHOWN_PLAN_CHANGED and nothing is recorded. The exact selection is stored as evidence, once per session. The same Idempotency-Key and selection return the original 201 response (the code is not part of the comparison). No payment link is made: the shop takes payment on Paytm. Location points at the receipt. Needs the confirmed budget and a requested, unexpired, matching code.

READY_TO_PAY means the shop now takes payment on Paytm; PAID, PAYMENT_PENDING and PAYMENT_NOT_COMPLETED arrive in Phase 3C, each with a next step. The cooling-off wording is a placeholder until the lender confirms its period. There is no payment URL.

AlternativeKind.title: AlternativeKind
AlternativeKind.description: How an alternative changes the purchase; values travel on the wire.

BasePlanResponse.title: BasePlanResponse
BasePlanResponse.description: The chosen plan ("Your plan" on C6) with its budget fit and comfort.

ComfortBand.title: ComfortBand
ComfortBand.description:
How a plan's monthly amount sits against the customer's monthly inflow (ADR 0020).

There are exactly three bands (CLAUDE.md section 2, rule 5). Values travel on the wire and are
mapped to translated words with an icon by the frontend; colour is never the only signal.

ComfortCheckRequest.title: ComfortCheckRequest
ComfortCheckRequest.description: The customer's C3 choice: allow the comfort check, or skip it (always allowed).

ComfortCheckResponse.title: ComfortCheckResponse
ComfortCheckResponse.description:
The customer's own monthly figures read for the check; both are null when skipped.

This is a customer endpoint: the merchant never sees these figures (CLAUDE.md section 2).

ComfortCheckStatus.title: ComfortCheckStatus
ComfortCheckStatus.description: Whether the customer let the comfort check run (C3); skipping is always allowed.

ConfirmBudgetRequest.title: ConfirmBudgetRequest
ConfirmBudgetRequest.description:
The monthly amount the customer is comfortable paying, confirmed on screen by them.

hasCustomerConfirmed must be true: a typed or spoken amount counts only once confirmed.

ConfirmedBudgetResponse.title: ConfirmedBudgetResponse
ConfirmedBudgetResponse.description: The monthly budget now held for the session.

ConsentResponse.title: ConsentResponse
ConsentResponse.description: The recorded consent: the exact plan agreed to, frozen, and the hand-off status.

ConsentedPlanResponse.title: ConsentedPlanResponse
ConsentedPlanResponse.description:
The frozen selection: the plan's schedule plus product, price and down payment.

priceInPaise is the product's price; financedAmountInPaise is the price less the down
payment, which the installments repay with any extra.

CoolingOffNoticeStatus.title: CoolingOffNoticeStatus
CoolingOffNoticeStatus.description: Whether the cooling-off wording is the lender's confirmed text or still a placeholder.

CustomerPlanResponse.title: CustomerPlanResponse
CustomerPlanResponse.description:
One plan card: each month and extra in total side by side, budget fit and comfort.

monthlyInstallmentInPaise is the lender's quoted figure; the other amounts are our exact
schedule (ADR 0001). Budget fit uses the largest single installment (ADR 0020 decision 3).
reasonCodes state facts only. comfort is null when the comfort check was skipped.

CustomerPlansResponse.title: CustomerPlansResponse
CustomerPlansResponse.description: Every plan for the budget; when none fits, all are still listed as above budget.

CustomerReceiptResponse.title: CustomerReceiptResponse
CustomerReceiptResponse.description:
The receipt; READY_TO_PAY means the merchant now takes payment on Paytm.

There is no payment URL: the merchant performs the payment step (CLAUDE.md section 2, rule 9).
coolingOffNoticeStatus PLACEHOLDER means the cooling-off wording awaits the lender's period.

CustomerSessionResponse.title: CustomerSessionResponse
CustomerSessionResponse.description: The session opened by the QR: send sessionToken as X-Customer-Session-Token from now on.

EmiType.title: EmiType
EmiType.description: The pricing kind of an EMI plan; stored by value inside frozen offer snapshots.

FieldErrorResponse.title: FieldErrorResponse
FieldErrorResponse.description: One invalid request field, named as on the wire, with an English message.

GiveConsentRequest.title: GiveConsentRequest
GiveConsentRequest.description:
The exact selection agreed to, the figures shown, the 6-digit code and the agreement.

The selection is the offer, the product (null for the session's item, or a cheaper model
from the alternatives) and the down payment (0 for none, else exactly the one suggested).
It is re-quoted server-side; if the shown monthly or total no longer match, the answer is
409 SHOWN_PLAN_CHANGED and nothing is recorded (ADR 0021).

OtpChallengeResponse.title: OtpChallengeResponse
OtpChallengeResponse.description: Where the code went (only the last two digits) and when it ends or can be re-sent.

PlanAlternativeResponse.title: PlanAlternativeResponse
PlanAlternativeResponse.description:
One option: down payment, longer tenure or cheaper model, kept even if it costs more.

financedAmountInPaise is what the plan spreads over its months: the price less any down
payment. The two monthly figures are the lender's quoted ones; isLowerMonthlyAmount and the
budget fit compare the largest single installments (ADR 0020 decision 3).

PlanAlternativesRequest.title: PlanAlternativesRequest
PlanAlternativesRequest.description: The plan the customer is looking at; alternatives are found for it.

PlanAlternativesResponse.title: PlanAlternativesResponse
PlanAlternativesResponse.description: The chosen plan and every option; hasLowerMonthlyAlternative false is "nothing better".

PlanComfortResponse.title: PlanComfortResponse
PlanComfortResponse.description:
One plan's band and shares of monthly inflow; advice, not a credit decision.

comfortRatioInBasisPoints is (existing EMIs + this plan) / inflow, rounded half-up once, and
the band is classified on it. The two shares are rounded on their own, so they may add up to
one basis point more or less than the total (ADR 0020 decision 4).

PlanReasonCode.title: PlanReasonCode
PlanReasonCode.description:
A fact about a plan that the frontend turns into translated text (ADR 0020 decision 5).

Declaration order is the order codes are listed on a plan. There is deliberately no code that
recommends a plan (CLAUDE.md section 2, rule 7).

detail.title: Detail
examples: The chosen offer is not quoted for this item and price.

fieldErrors.title: Fielderrors
fieldErrors.description: Set only on request validation problems.

ProblemDetailsResponse.title: ProblemDetailsResponse
ProblemDetailsResponse.description:
An error: a stable code for the UI to translate and an English detail for developers.

It never holds a stack trace, SQL, a vendor payload or personal data.

ReceiptStatus.title: ReceiptStatus
ReceiptStatus.description:
Where the purchase stands on the receipt (C10); a failed payment explains the next step.

READY_TO_PAY is the hand-off state: the merchant now takes payment on Paytm. The other
states arrive with payment status in Phase 3C.

StartCustomerSessionRequest.title: StartCustomerSessionRequest
StartCustomerSessionRequest.description: The token read from the QR the merchant shows; it is never logged.

CustomerSessionToken.description: The sessionToken from POST /customer-sessions; short-lived and bound to one session. Missing, wrong or ended tokens answer 401 CUSTOMER_SESSION_TOKEN_INVALID.
